title: Earth's Day Was 1.66 Milliseconds Shorter
hook: Earth just recorded a day 1.66 milliseconds shorter.
closing: Even tiny changes can force the clocks that coordinate your world to adjust.
question: Do your days feel shorter?

segments.say: A recent day was 1.66 milliseconds shorter than normal, proving Earth's rotation is speeding up.
Timekeepers added 27 leap seconds as Earth's rotation shifted, but have never removed one.
Experts put the chance of a negative leap second at 40 percent, a first for modern timekeeping.
